mapper.select: SELECT country_code AS code,country_name AS name,region,status FROM country_master ORDER BY status,country_code LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT currency_code AS code,currency_name AS name,symbol,decimal_places,status FROM currency_master ORDER BY status,currency_code LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT cc.country_code AS countryCode,c.country_name AS countryName,cc.currency_code AS currencyCode,cu.currency_name AS currencyName,cc.status FROM country_currency_master cc JOIN country_master c ON c.country_code=cc.country_code JOIN currency_master cu ON cu.currency_code=cc.currency_code ORDER BY cc.status,cc.country_code,cc.currency_code LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT country_code AS code,country_name AS name,region,status FROM country_master WHERE status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY country_name

SELECT cu.currency_code AS code,cu.currency_name AS name,cu.symbol,cu.decimal_places,cu.status FROM currency_master cu JOIN country_currency_master cc ON cc.currency_code=cu.currency_code JOIN country_master c ON c.country_code=cc.country_code WHERE cc.country_code=#{countryCode} AND cc.status='ACTIVE' AND c.status='ACTIVE' AND cu.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY cu.currency_codeWHERE cu.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY cu.currency_code
